description: This PHP source file defines the 'PerformanceReviewSearchFilterParams' class, a data transfer object used for filtering and managing search parameters related to performance reviews within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes constants for allowed sorting fields and statuses, properties for various filter criteria, and getter/setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class encapsulating search filter parameters for performance review queries, including sorting options, statuses, employee identifiers, date ranges, and related filters.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the reviewer employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the reviewer employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getSubunitId
methods.description: Returns the subunit ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setSubunitId
methods.description: Sets the subunit ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getStatusId
methods.description: Returns the status ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setStatusId
methods.description: Sets the status ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date filter for the search.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date filter for the search.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date filter for the search.

methods.name: setToDate

methods.name: isExcludeInactiveReviews
methods.description: Returns whether inactive reviews are excluded in the filter.

methods.name: setExcludeInactiveReviews

methods.description: Returns the employee inclusion filter criterion.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the employee inclusion filter criterion.
